components: Three equal opposite-preparation mixtures coincide on the original dials but a common right contact separates them. A left-wire swap gives a second-minus-first gap of 1/8 for every admissible probability stock giving the exact solo row in this model.

Equal rates across the three mixtures and rate one half are distinct operational requirements. The closed macro census containing the original dial has respective maxima of order 24 and 12. The latter is noncommuting but adds no new analyzer row on the six stocks.

A superficially safe swap fails after composition with the dial. Access to completed macros only, rather than all internal prefixes, is a supplied restriction. Separate even and odd fair triads have the same latent distribution as a positive equivalence control.
candidates.declared_status: Exact finite scope tests for preparations and composition-closed analyzer libraries. If the expanded library distinguishes the mixtures, they are not operationally equivalent there; this is not preparation contextuality.
missing_bridges: Specify and independently justify which transformations, preparations and analyzers a physical apparatus actually permits, including internal prefixes and classical randomization.
Establish operational equivalences with a justified completeness contract before using them for contextuality or comparing the stocks to antipodal quantum preparations.

P_k has four fair tickets at phases k,k+1,k+1,k+2 of the center seed.
M_k is a fair choice between P_k and P_(k+3). One common word g is applied
after preparation, then the same terminal first-wire detector is used for
all mixtures. No intermediate decisions. Baseline dial powers all return
one half. A single right contact gives 4,3,5 out of eight. A wire swap
(two left contacts) accepts 1,2,1 and has an even stronger property: its
second-minus-first difference 1/8 survives *every* nonnegative probability
stock on all 125 triples giving the same six solo rates with this W and D.
The fixed background tag is zero. The readout is unchanged, not retuned.

In a separately certified qubit sector with antipodal pure states, each
equal opposite mixture has density I/2: every common effect gives equal
rates (not necessarily 1/2 for an arbitrary effect). The six-dial table
alone does not certify those states, a two-dimensional physical sector,
or tomographic completeness. Here the enlarged measurement set explicitly
breaks operational equivalence. This is NOT a preparation-contextuality
violation, an experimental exclusion, or a conclusion about general F5
devices. Counts are model rates, not observed frequencies or error bars.

The six P_k and detector D are exactly the center-defect four-ticket
preparations and terminal equality-OR reader of the neighboring probes.
For M_k=(P_k+P_(k+3))/2, distinguish two supplied comparison requirements:
E: all three M_k rates are equal for every accessible effect;
H: all are one half for every accessible reversible rank-one qubit analyzer.
H is stronger; E alone permits a zero effect. Neither comparison certifies
that these finite stocks actually are antipodal pure qubit states.

Enumerate all subgroups containing W in the native GL2(5) action. A finite
composition-closed reversible library containing identity is a subgroup:
each inverse is a positive power. No inverse pulse is therefore free here.
The enumeration rejects a branch on its first forbidden element and adds
every remaining permissible generator, so it exhausts admissible groups,
not merely individually passing gates. Independent old-analyzer shifts
give a second certificate of the unique maximal permissible sets.

Libraries contain completed macros, with D only at their end. The gate
letters used inside a macro are not separately accessible analyzers in
this restricted stance. Allowing every native prefix restores all 480
maps and fails. The largest H library is noncommuting but supplies no new
detector row on these six stocks beyond the original six dials. Source,
reference, fair tickets, equality/OR detector, and restriction to chosen
macros remain supplied. No empirical data, contextuality conclusion,
universal proof, physical exclusion, or QM derivation is asserted.

This does not classify stochastic channels with cancellation between
individually failing components, adaptive/intermediate measurements,
different sources/readers, ancillas, or larger native systems.
